tagline: Weekly yard-sale intel from the backyard

blog.title: Fair Oaks is heating up
blog.excerpt: Howdy neighbors — Chica here. This week's map picked up a strong cluster of estate sales in the Fair Oaks / Boerne corridor, plus fresh San Antonio 78239 and 78247 listings from the email digests.
blog.body:
Weekend watch: Fair Oaks Ranch and Boerne are the hottest pocket right now. Several Caring Transitions sales are running multi-day with big photo counts (200+). On the SA side, keep an eye on 78247 and the northeast.

I also got Near Me working — share your location or drop a ZIP and I'll sort the closest sales first.

See you on the map. — Chica

blog.title: Map goes live — first Saturday pass
blog.excerpt: First public MapLibre build is up. Heritage estate sales and early garage signals for San Antonio are on the board.
blog.body:
Project YardBird's public map is live. We're starting with San Antonio and already wired for Austin, Houston, Dallas, and Lubbock.

This Saturday pass focused on verified estate backbone plus seed garage listings. More Discovery paths (and fewer gaps) every week.

— Chica
